name: ui-carousel
description: Bootstrap carousel on scroll snap: controls, indicators, play/pause, top/bottom/overlay, fade, several items, peek, variable width, centre, autoplay with per-slide intervals, loop/wrap/stop, data API.

descriptions.--bs-carousel-gap: Space between the slides and the control rows.
descriptions.--bs-carousel-indicator-width: Width of an indicator (the active one: 2.5 times).
descriptions.--bs-carousel-indicator-opacity-duration: Duration of the indicator opacity transition.
descriptions.--bs-carousel-indicator-width-duration: Duration of the indicator width transition.
descriptions.--bs-carousel-indicator-progress-bg: Fill of the active indicator while autoplaying.
descriptions.--bs-carousel-control-prev-icon: Mask image of the previous icon.
descriptions.--bs-carousel-control-next-icon: Mask image of the next icon.
descriptions.--bs-carousel-control-pause-icon: Mask image of the pause icon.
descriptions.--bs-carousel-control-play-icon: Mask image of the play icon.
descriptions.--bs-carousel-items-peek: How much of the neighbouring slides shows.
descriptions.--bs-carousel-interval: Duration of the indicator progress (set by the autoplay from the interval).
